testcase.name: Invalid contexts (NaN or infinite anchor, negative owner or world id): the delivery is rejected whole
A viewer with a NaN position is refused (VIEWER_POSITION_INVALID); the other viewers are unaffected
One mismatched context (ring B's slot names ring A, owner A): only ring B is rejected; ring A is unaffected
Control: valid contexts; each owner sees its own ring; non-owners without view are refused; accounting balances
Swapped contexts (key ring A holds ring B's context with owner B, and vice versa): both deliveries rejected, nothing sent
